TABLE.NAME: webcoached
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the webcoached activity module instances.

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the course this activity is part of.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The name of the activity module instance

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The format of the intro field.

FIELD.NAME: remotecourseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Numeric internal Webcoached course ID sent as course_id during SSO login (e.g. 1111, 1112, 1113).

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Grade aggregate: positive value = max points, negative value = scale id, 0 = no grade.

FIELD.NAME: messagebody
FIELD.COMMENT: Body of the notification sent to the learner when the send_message REST call is triggered. Supports {name} and {link} placeholders. Empty falls back to the language default.

FIELD.NAME: messagebodyformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The text format of the messagebody field.

FIELD.NAME: popup
FIELD.COMMENT: Display mode: 0 = current window, 1 = new popup window.

FIELD.NAME: popupwidth
FIELD.COMMENT: Width of the popup window in pixels.

FIELD.NAME: popupheight
FIELD.COMMENT: Height of the popup window in pixels.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was added to the course.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was last modified.
